parameters.content:
## Google Vids Talking Avatar App: AI avatar video with Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash

**Who it's for:** marketers, educators, course creators and social media teams who want a short talking avatar video, a presenter saying your line in a chosen voice, without filming anyone.

It runs on **your own Google account** through the [useapi.net Google Vids API](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-vids-v1?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=vids-avatar-app), a third-party API, and uses that account's monthly Google Vids allowance.

**How it works**
1. The form: describe a new presenter or choose one of your saved presenters, pick one of the 30 Gemini voices, write the line and the scene, and choose format, length (3 to 10 s) and resolution. Add up to 3 more segments, each with its own line, for a video of up to 40 s.
2. Google Vids draws the presenter as an **AI avatar**. A page shows the portrait and plays the voice: use it, or re-draw with a new description. Saved presenters show as a gallery with pictures and voice samples.
3. **Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash** films the avatar saying your line at 720p. Each extra segment extends the clip; a page previews each step and lets you stop early. The optional 1080p upscale runs last, for videos of up to 20 s. Pages carry a resume link.
4. The result page plays the MP4 with a download link, shows the seconds used with a cost estimate, and the avatar ID to reuse.

**Errors:** busy accounts and short rate limits are retried. Paid requests are never sent twice: a job that may already be charged stops with its job id.

**Set up**
1. Get a [useapi.net](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=vids-avatar-app) API token and connect your Google account with the [Google Vids setup](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-google-vids?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=vids-avatar-app).
2. Create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your API token>`. Select it on every HTTP Request node.
3. Publish (activate) the workflow and open the form URL.

**Requirements:** a useapi.net subscription and a Google account on a paid Google AI plan with Google Vids. A clip uses its seconds of the monthly allowance, a portrait 1 image.

**Customize:** prompts and defaults are in **Read the form**; the plan rates behind the cost estimate (Ultra $199 = 10,000 s) are at the top of **Result page**. Scripts: [GitHub](https://github.com/useapi/google-vids-api).

### 1. The form
A new presenter's description or the saved-presenter gallery, voice, the line, the scene, format, length and resolution. **Read the form** builds the prompt: the scene, then `@avatar_1` looks into the camera and says your line.

### 2. The presenter
**Create avatar** draws a new presenter (1 image), or **Find saved avatar** lists your saved ones (free). **Your presenter** shows the portrait and voice, or a numbered gallery to pick from. A re-draw removes the rejected portrait first.

### 3. Video, extends and upscale
One job at a time: the 720p clip, then each segment as an extend of the clip so far (named by look, since an extend takes no avatar), then the optional 1080p upscale (up to 20 s). **Segment ready** previews each step. Polled every 10 s. Paid requests are never retried by n8n; only answers that made nothing (busy, short rate limit, not queued) are sent again after 30 s.

### 4. Result
**Your video** plays the MP4, links the download and shows the seconds used with a cost estimate (edit the rates at the top of **Result page**). A failed extend keeps the last good clip. The presenter can be kept or deleted.

### 5. Stops
A page says what to fix: token, allowance, refused prompt or signed-out account. A failed job that may be charged shows its job id.

### 6. Video file (player and download)
The portrait, the player and the download link call this webhook. It fetches the file with your credential, so the token never reaches the browser, and it accepts only a Vids mediaId.
